description: This file defines a client interface and its implementation for managing polled device connections, including message handling, connection creation, and disconnection.

classes.name: PolledClient
classes.description: Implements a client that communicates with a device via a polled connection, managing messages and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: PolledSet
classes.description: Manages a set of polled clients, providing methods to create, retrieve, and destroy client connections.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the device, adding it to the client's message queue.

methods.name: OnDeviceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles device disconnection, cleaning up resources associated with the client.

methods.name: ToDevice
methods.description: Sends a message directly to the connected device.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages from the client's message queue starting from a specific index.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the client.

methods.name: ClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID assigned by the device.

methods.name: NewConnection
methods.description: Creates a new polled client connection for a given device.

methods.name: GetConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a connection by its ID.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Removes a connection from the set by its ID.
